project_title: Licensed Electrical PE (NV) Needed to Review & Stamp Electrical As‑Built Drawings

project_metadata.job_title: Licensed Electrical PE (NV) Needed to Review & Stamp Electrical As‑Built Drawings
project_metadata.job_description:
We are seeking a Licensed Electrical Professional Engineer (PE) to review and stamp the electrical as‑built drawings for a completed project at a Healthcare System (North Las Vegas, NV).

We need an Electrical PE to provide discipline‑specific concurrence for the electrical modifications.

This is a small‑scope, low‑complexity electrical job.
No load calculations, no panel upgrades, and no redesign are required.

What We Need From You
Review the electrical as‑built sheets (PDF)
Provide PE stamp + signature on the electrical sheets

milestones._note: milestone_description and submission_feedback are masked by a Snowflake data policy under current role access; submission matched via latest-submission-per-milestone heuristic, not event-log pairing

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hello [CLIENT_NAME_001], I couldn't view any attachment if you sent one.
Please resend the file so I can provide an accurate quote.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I'll review it and respond to you in a few minutes.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Yes, I can assist with stamping your project.

messages.text: Given the project's simplicity, I expect the review and stamp to be completed in 2 business days. Since this is a very simple change, I was also hoping to have it stamped for \$100. Please let me know. Thanks

messages.text:

Would $200-250 work, with completion within the next 24-36 hours?

messages.speaker: freelancer

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The 36 pages may look daunting, but you do not actually need to review all of them. I initially felt the same way, but the work only involves reviewing the minor modifications identified in the word file. I am the mechanical PE for this change, and my scope ultimately came down to the attached file\(only highlighted portion\). The electrical situation is the same. If it works for you, let’s finalize this at \$150, and I will notify the client. Please advise.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okayyy, let's procced

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Please send a contract so we can begin.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thanks. I will inform the client and initiate the offer as soon as I receive confirmation. Thanks

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Alright

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Additionally, could you let me know whether you can support me with the attached project? Please provide your price and timeline for permit-ready Mechanical, Plumbing and Electrical drawings with an electrical PE stamp\(I will do Mechanical and Plumbing stamp\).

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes, I can assist with that too.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: what is your budget?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Please provide a reasonable quote, and I will confirm with the client whether it fits his budget.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Would $300 work?
Also, when will the project be ready to kickoff?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For this one, the client is asking whether you require redline drawings or can stamp it based on the provided description file explaining what changed.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: In my opinion, the redlined drawing is the best file to stamp because it shows what was completed in response to the previous comment.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Okay, I will ask the client accident. This will cover permit-ready Mechanical, Plumbing and Electrical drawings, including all required load calculations\(T 24 not needed but HvAC sizing calculations\), correct? Could you also provide your electrical PE license number for California? The project should kick off soon \(not more than in two weeks\).

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I understood that the scope was only review and stamp. Am I also expected to provide additional drawings and calculations?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Understood. What if the client supplies pictures of the changes that align with the description? If you still require redlines, I will request them; I only wanted to confirm the minimum needed to kickoff the project.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Typically, the minimum information I would need to kick off the project is:
The written scope of work, which has already been provided
Photos showing each modified area
The room numbers connected to each change
Any sketches, screenshots, or informal markups indicating the approximate work locations

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Electrical PE details:
Name: ADLER J ROBERT
License Number: 16119

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Apologies for the delayed reply. You would prepare the drawings and stamp the electrical drawings \(I will stamp mechanical\). You would also complete whatever calculations are required to produce the drawings \(please let me know if that is within your competence\). This includes Manual. J, Manual S,,Manual D as applicable.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For this scope, what price and timeline would you propose?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Thank you for the clarification. Yes, this scope is within my capabilities. My estimated fee for the electrical permit drawings, PE stamp, required electrical calculations, and Manual J/S/D calculations as applicable would be $5,000–$8,000, with an approximate turnaround of 3–4 weeks, provided that the architectural background files are complete and permit-ready.

This is an extensive scope.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hmm, that seems like a lot. Just out of curiosity, have you completed projects of a similar size, and do clients typically pay this much? I am asking because I do not want to accept a job that is too large and cannot be delivered, while also wanting to make sure the price I request is not totally outside the normal spectrum. Thanks for your help, Abigail

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes, I have completed projects with similar size and complexity, and fees within this range are quite typical when calculations, permit drawings, and PE stamping are included. Your pricing does not seem outside the market. The important part is ensuring that you are comfortable with the scope and can confidently support the project throughout permitting.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Understood. I will present this pricing to the client and let you know what feedback I receive. Thanks

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: My Pleasure
